merged_from: The CLEAR path introduced by this diff — a non-sub-task parent_key of None mapped to the sentinel epic 'none' (transport.py:730) — is never exercised. The docstring explicitly claims the greenhopper sentinel epic 'none' expresses a CLEAR, but no test calls set_parent(remote_id, None) on a non-sub-task, so the branch that substitutes 'none' and the resulting add_issues_to_epic('none', ...) call are untested.

The deliberately-preserved conditional decline (NotImplementedError when the injected client exposes no add_issues_to_epic, transport.py:721-729) is not covered by the new test module: its _FakeClient always defines add_issues_to_epic, so the adder-is-None branch never runs. This branch is a behavior this diff CHANGED (from an unconditional decline to a conditional one); its only incidental coverage is a pre-existing test whose docstring now describes the old unconditional decline.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a unit test asserting build_client_from_settings passes options['agile_rest_path']=='greenhopper' (reuse the existing _built_client_kwargs/_Spy capture harness).
evidence: transport.py:168 `options: dict[str, Any] = {"agile_rest_path": "greenhopper"}`

Diff commit body: 'the epic-link route is unreachable otherwise' / ticket comment: 'Without it the call targets the agile path DC does not expose, so the epic-link route would have been DEAD ON ARRIVAL.'

Existing capture harness that already asserts on the options dict but not this key: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_jira_dc_transport_heldout.py:37-64 (_built_client_kwargs/_Spy) and test_jira_dc_config_settings.py:207-227 (_Spy captures options, asserts options.get('verify'))
ABSENCE: search_files for 'agile_rest_path' returns only src (transport.py:168 and docstrings) and no test assertion.
advisory.finding: The load-bearing new option options={'agile_rest_path':'greenhopper'} added to build_client_from_settings (transport.py:168) has no test asserting it, even though the change narrative and docstring say the epic-link route is 'DEAD ON ARRIVAL' without it. Existing tests capture and assert on the options dict (options['verify']) via the _built_client_kwargs/_Spy harness, but none assert options['agile_rest_path']=='greenhopper'. A regression that dropped or renamed this option would pass the whole unit suite while silently breaking the feature on a live DC.
